note: Adapted from the entry in Fauna Sinica, originally in Chinese; entry 57, the soldier and the alate are recorded, and the values in the measurement table are transcribed as given; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown to dark brown, the postmentum nearly black, the submentum paler than the postmentum, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, mandibles black, pronotum and legs pale yellow, abdomen yellowish white; head with long setae, body with sparse long setae. The sides of the head near the anterior end converge slightly, the head subquadrate; the anterior part of the frons is inclined and bears a median groove reaching the occiput, the Y-shaped suture indistinct; compound eyes small and prominent, maximum diameter 0.15–0.25 mm, oval, the minimum distance between the compound eye and the antennal fossa shorter than or equal to the eye diameter; ocelli absent; antennae 16-segmented, segment 1 longest and largest, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 smallest, about half of segment 2, segments 5–15 progressively longer, the terminal segment shorter than the penultimate; postclypeus quadrate, anteclypeus trapezoidal and longer than the postclypeus, labrum quadrate, about as long as wide, anterior margin straight or slightly produced at the middle; mandibles long and stout, about 2/3 of the head length, the corresponding index 0.64–0.66, straight and slightly concave, stouter at the base; left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, the first marginal tooth plate-like, the second triangular and about as long as the first, the third smaller, the fourth and fifth nearly triangular with a shallow notch between them; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the inner margin wavy, the apical tooth about 1.5 times as long as the apical tooth of the left mandible, the first marginal tooth triangular and rather large, the second marginal tooth smaller than the first; postmentum long, rod-shaped and rather flat, broad anteriorly, abruptly narrowed in the middle, the posterior end broader than the anterior one, the anterior broad part about half the postmental length, in profile divided into two equal lobes, the anterior margin rather straight, the posterior margin wavy; pronotum subrectangular, about as wide as the head, in profile the dorsal margin straight and not saddle-shaped, anterior margin broad and slightly concave, sides arcuate, posterior margin rather straight with a median notch; legs slender and long, tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Measurements: body length 10.2–11.0 mm; head length to mandibular base 2.70–3.30 mm; maximum head width 2.00–2.40 mm; head height 1.50–1.70 mm; head width/head length 0.73–0.74; labrum length 0.30–0.35 mm, maximum width 0.40–0.50 mm; left mandible length 1.70–2.00 mm; mandible length/head length 0.64–0.67, mandible length/head width 0.88–0.90; compound eye diameter 0.15–0.25 mm; postmental median length 1.9–2.2 mm, maximum width 0.80 mm, minimum width 0.30 mm; pronotal length 1.1–1.4 mm, width 2.0–2.6 mm; pronotal width/head width 1.0–1.05; hind tibia length 1.2–1.4 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale brown to reddish brown, the base of the antennae dark and the apex pale, pronotum, legs and abdomen slightly paler; pilosity sparse, the apical margin of the labrum with long setae, the pronotum with a few long soft hairs. Head subquadrate, the width between the compound eyes slightly greater than the width at the mandibular base; the anterior part of the frons is inclined and bears a Y-shaped suture, the median groove distinct; compound eyes rather large, circular, ocelli oval, white and translucent, situated at the lower end of the compound eye and contiguous with it; antennae 17–19-segmented, segment 1 long and large, segment 2 about half as long as segment 1 and slightly longer than or equal to segment 3, segment 4 shortest, segment 5 to the penultimate progressively longer, the terminal segment slightly shorter than the penultimate; postclypeus subrectangular, rather short and narrow, slightly higher than the frons, anteclypeus trapezoidal and longer than the postclypeus; labrum subquadrate, about as long as wide, anterior margin produced; left mandible with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth digitiform and longer than the marginal teeth, right mandible with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth slightly longer than the marginal teeth, the second marginal tooth shorter than the first; pronotum subrectangular, maximum width greater than the distance between the compound eyes, anterior margin rather broad and slightly incurved, posterior margin rather straight with a shallower median notch; legs slender and long, tibial apical spurs 3:3:3. Measurements: body length (with wings) 14.5–15.0 mm; body length (without wings) 8.2–8.6 mm; head length (to mandibular base) 1.4–1.5 mm; head width 1.6–1.7 mm; head height 0.8–1.0 mm; labrum length 0.5 mm, width 0.5–0.55 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.5–0.55 mm; ocellus long diameter 0.15–0.2 mm; eye–antennal distance 0.5 mm; pronotal length 0.9–1.1 mm, width 1.8–2.1 mm; forewing length (including the wing scale) 11.6–12.4 mm; hindwing length 10.5–11.0 mm.
